state/numerical-methods.json.title: Numerical Methods
state/numerical-methods.json.goal: Explain and solve linear systems, including singular cases.

course_context.assessment: Short oral explanations followed by worked problems.
constraints: No numerical calculator is needed for this exercise.
unknowns: The actual examination date and full permitted aids are unknown.

free-parameter.text: On worksheet A, choose the free variable y=t and express x in terms of t.

assessment-aid.text: For the Numerical Methods 2026/27 oral examination, the official notice permits one A5 sheet of formulas, handwritten on one side. Worked derivations and worked solutions are not permitted. Calculator rules are not specified in the notice.
assessment-aid.attribution: Official oral examination notice released 23 September 2026.

o1.text: The learner recognized that the equations coincide after the tutor pointed out that the second is twice the first.
o1.response: They are the same line, so there are infinitely many solutions.
o1.assistance: The tutor explicitly identified the second equation as twice the first.

worksheet-a-5b.question: Return from the dependent-equations explanation to parameterize every solution.
worksheet-a-5b.assistance: Dependence and infinite solution count were already explained.

frame.goal: Classify and parameterize this system's solution set.
frame.completion: All solutions expressed using one real parameter.

worksheet-b-5b.question: An unrelated exercise, not the interrupted worksheet A problem.

state/signals-studio.json.title: Signals Studio
state/signals-studio.json.goal: Connect response, stability and frequency using course notation.

notation.text: For the current Signals Studio lab, use discrete-time notation such as impulse response $g[n]$; Atlas may use $h$ for impulse response in derivations, and old continuous-time lab sheets may write $g(t)$.
notation.attribution: Learner-reported lecturer clarification plus the course files' stated conventions.
notation.uncertainty: The lecturer clarification is a learner report rather than a newly dated source; the Lumen notes themselves have not been independently inspected in this vault.

resources.text: Lecturer clarification reported by the learner: the old laboratory sheets assume continuous time, but the current lab is discrete time. Use Lumen for current conventions; Atlas remains useful for longer derivations. This supersedes the learner's earlier impression that the older laboratory sheets tracked the current lecturer's assumptions.
resources.attribution: Learner report of lecturer clarification, alongside the undated lab notice/sheet conflict.
resources.uncertainty: The lecturer clarification is not a newly dated source; the available notice and sheet still supply no issue date or edition identifier.
